task.title: Align Rust SDK feature parity with TypeScript SDK

raw.reasoning: This closes user-visible feature gaps quickly while preserving Rust SDK idioms and minimizing breaking changes.

retrospective.summary: Added Rust SDK parity features with TypeScript: workspace stream APIs, workspace channels/messages APIs, agent spawn/release APIs, workspace DM message listing, heartbeat/disconnect parity, origin metadata headers/query params, and relaycast.dev defaults; added parity integration tests and verified with cargo test.
